title: Veeam Backup & Replication
description: Jobs, objects, repositories, license and exporter health from vbr-textfile-exporter (windows_exporter textfile collector).

panels.title: Jobs failed
panels.description: Jobs whose last run failed. A failure inside the retry window is normal (alert VeeamJobFailed waits 45 min).

panels.title: Jobs with warning
panels.description: Jobs whose last run ended with a warning.

panels.title: Objects failed
panels.description: VMs and other objects whose most recent task run failed: not backed up.

panels.title: Repositories offline
panels.description: Repositories and SOBR extents reported offline.

panels.title: Repositories > 85 %
panels.description: Fill level computed as 1 - free / capacity. Repositories without capacity (object storage) are skipped.

panels.title: Collectors failing
panels.description: Exporter collectors whose last run failed. Their .prom file keeps the old data, see Exporter health.

panels.title: Textfile errors
panels.description: windows_exporter could not read a .prom file. In that case it drops ALL textfile metrics of the server.

panels.title: License expires in
panels.description: Days until the license expires (earliest of the selected servers). Empty for perpetual licenses.

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: One row per job from veeam_jobs.prom. Since last run turns yellow after 26 h; the alert VeeamJobNotRun fires then too, except for jobs with schedule Manual (started by hand). Schedule: Scheduled, Chained (runs after another job) or Manual.

targets.expr: max by (instance, job_name, job_type, workload, repository, schedule) (veeam_job_info{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Objects by last result
panels.description: Most recent task run per job and object within the exporter's lookback (8 days).

panels.title: Objects with warning or failure
panels.description: Objects whose most recent task run ended with Warning or Failed. A successful retry removes the row.

targets.expr: max by (instance, job_name, object) (veeam_object_last_run_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"} and on (instance, job_name, object) veeam_object_last_result{instance=~"$instance"} >= 1) * 1000
max by (instance, job_name, object) (veeam_object_last_processed_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} and on (instance, job_name, object) veeam_object_last_result{instance=~"$instance"} >= 1)

panels.title: Fill level
panels.description: 1 - free / capacity per repository or SOBR extent. Yellow from 75 %, red from 85 % (alert VeeamRepositoryFull).

panels.title: Repositories
panels.description: Backup files is the space used by backups, not the volume usage (see docs/metrics.md).

targets.expr: max by (instance, repository, repository_type, host, sobr) (veeam_repository_capacity_bytes{instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, repository, repository_type, host, sobr) (veeam_repository_free_bytes{instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, repository, repository_type, host, sobr) (veeam_repository_backup_bytes{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Fill level over time
panels.description: Same expression as Fill level. Dashed line: 85 % alert threshold.

panels.title: License
panels.description: From the daily license task (Get-VBRInstalledLicense). Dates are missing when not set, e.g. perpetual licenses.

targets.expr: max by (instance, edition, license_type, status, licensed_to) (veeam_license_info{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Exporter health
panels.description: A failed collector keeps its old .prom file, so Data age shows since when its data is stale. REST collectors run every 15 min, license once a day.

panels.title: Exporter version
panels.description: VBR version: file version of the Veeam backup service on the server, empty if it cannot be read (OP-13 in docs/metrics.md).
